facts.fact: MISA Zimbabwe says the Cyber and Data Protection Act [Chapter 12:07] was gazetted on 3 December 2021 and came into force the same day.
MISA Zimbabwe says Statutory Instrument 155 of 2024, promulgated on 13 September 2024, requires data controller licences and Data Protection Officers within six months.
MISA Zimbabwe says licence applications under SI 155 of 2024 go to the Data Authority, the Postal and Telecommunications Regulatory Authority of Zimbabwe (POTRAZ).
